name: ultimate-agent-stack
description: Your Project Steward with verified continuity and replaceable review, knowledge, and telemetry providers.

interface.longDescription: Safely installs and updates a repository, guides consequential decisions with recommendations, preserves verified cross-conversation checkpoints, tests optional project memory, uses scoped read-only telemetry as advisory evidence, prevents competing checkout coordinators, manages bounded native subagents, verifies behavior, and closes review loops while preserving human authority.
interface.defaultPrompt: Act as my Project Steward. Use $run-autonomous-delivery to load verified continuity and take my request through review closure. If this repository is not configured yet, run $setup-autonomous-project first.
